king noun

in cards, chess or draughts

also king (playing card), king (chess piece), king (in draughts), crown (in draughts), crowned piece

modern

Traupman 51–52

Andresian pp. 16–17
Traupman 286
Traupman 289

rēx, rēgis m.

noun, third declension

The same word as for the monarch (see king), for the card, the chess piece and the crowned piece in draughts (Traupman 51).

Other words

  • corōna, corōnae f. — a crowned piece in draughts

    noun, first declension · also used · modern · Andresian p. 17

    Andresian’s name for the doubled piece; classically a garland or crown.

  • corōnō, corōnāre, corōnāvī, corōnātum — crown a piece, make it a king

    verb, first conjugation · also used · modern · Traupman 51; Andresian p. 17

    Classically to crown with a garland.

See also queen, jack, chess, draughts, king, checkmate.
